content:
alex: Heads-up — candidate Aisha for SRE onsite booked an early AM flight, ETA ~8:10am but visa queue could add unknown delay. Can we move panel start to 10:30 and reserve a quiet room for her to rest + test Zoom? Also need a laptop loaner and transit stipend. cc @marta @zach
marta: On it. I can shift panels to 10:30 — which interviewers should I notify?
zach: I can handle the laptop loaner. Do we need mac or linux image? Will courier be used or pickup at reception?
alex: Linux image is fine. Candidate notes vegetarian + nut allergy. If arrival looks pushed past 11am, can we fallback to do first two loops remote?
peopleops-bot: Reserved Quiet Room B (Building A, 2nd floor) from 09:00-14:00 and placed calendar hold. :white_check_mark:
marta: I'll update the calendar invites and ping interviewers. Planning to notify: @leah @omar @jordan — leah, can you confirm availability at 10:30?
leah: 10:30 works for me. I'll be remote-ready if she can't make it in person. Please DM ETA updates.
alex: I'll ask Aisha to text when through immigration. Can we pre-stage loaner + charger on the desk with VPN access enabled? Tag IT so creds are ready.
zach: Yep — I'll label loaner "Aisha K - Do not reassign" and place at Reception Loaners. Will enable temp VPN creds. What username should I provision?
alex: Use `aisha.k@candidate.redwood` (temp). Set expiry to 48h. Also order lunch via caterer: vegetarian, no nuts, and a gluten-free option.
marta: Noted. I'll add dietary notes to the calendar and submit catering order.
alex: Also need transit stipend instructions — candidate should keep taxi receipt. I'll approve $50 transit stipend. Recruiter will process reimbursement.
marta: I'll create an expense code and send candidate the submission link. @peopleops-bot can you post the expense template?
peopleops-bot: Expense template added: https://redwood.internal/expenses/templates/candidate-transit — please attach receipt and submit within 14 days.
leah: Can we add an extra 15-min buffer between loops in the calendar so hosts can debrief?
marta: Good idea — adding 15m buffers. Also updating room booking notes with the loaner sticker and dietary flags.
alex: Perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup: If ETA changes I'll post here.
